task:
Implement `TokenBucket` in `src/limiter/bucket.py`.

`TokenBucket(capacity, refill_per_second)` starts full. `allow(now, cost=1)`
returns True and consumes `cost` tokens when at least `cost` tokens are
available, otherwise returns False and consumes nothing.

Refill happens lazily inside `allow`: tokens gained equal
`refill_per_second * (now - last_now)`, capped at `capacity`. `now` is a
float timestamp supplied by the caller. If `now` is earlier than the
previous call, treat elapsed time as zero. `capacity` and
`refill_per_second` must be greater than zero; otherwise raise ValueError
from the constructor. `cost` must be greater than zero; otherwise raise
ValueError from `allow`.
